nodes.title: Plivo's public India pages (fetched 2026-10-24): landline 080/022 needs one of GST/COI/Udyam, reviewed in about 5 minutes, ₹200 a month; 140-series ~5-10 business days and 160-series ~7-14 business days via Tata DLT (Mumbai/Karnataka telemarketers only), price not published; 1601 and mobile not published
nodes.method: curl of 5 public carrier pages, saved byte for byte with URL and fetch time; every figure in SERIES_GUIDE is asserted against the saved text by tests/numbers-kyc.test.ts

nodes.title: number.search always returns the per-series guide (checklist, typical time, monthly price, sources); with no carrier switched on it answers with no offers and telephony {state: off, code: telephony_disabled} instead of refusing
nodes.rationale: open.2026-10-24.numbers-kyc-before-search: a buyer must see what a line needs and costs before searching, and before a carrier is connected
nodes.reverse_if: the owner wants number search hidden entirely until a carrier is live

nodes.title: Every workspace starts with a ₹5,000 daily spend cap and a ₹2,000 burst limit (money held at once by calls in flight), both from money_config; owners lower them at once and raise them by approval
nodes.rationale: must-be audit gap 17 (bounded defaults): nothing should spend without bound before an owner sets limits. ₹2,000 held is about 33 ten-minute calls at the dial gate's ₹6/min fallback hold; ₹5,000 a day is roughly 2,500-3,500 connected minutes at measured provider cost. The burst is a budget row whose spend stays 0, so the kernel's reserve() enforces it under its own lock
nodes.reverse_if: design partners hit the defaults in normal use, or the owner sets other values (change money_config; existing workspaces keep their rows)

nodes.title: PlivoTelephony.systemCall: POST /v1/Account/{id}/Call/ with an answer URL on our /hooks/telephony/plivo/speak/<token> route serving Speak XML; behind VP_TELEPHONY_LIVE; tests use a fake Plivo on 127.0.0.1 only; needs VP_PUBLIC_URL (https) at runtime
System-call announcements wait in process memory for 15 minutes; with more than one control-plane replica the carrier's answer request can land on a replica that does not hold the lines
nodes.mitigation: before scaling past one replica, move the token -> lines store to Postgres (one small table) or sign the lines into the token

events.what: Money/numbers brief 2: number.search guide per series from saved Plivo pages (works with telephony off); PlivoTelephony.systemCall with a speak hook, tested on a fake Plivo; default ₹5,000 daily cap and ₹2,000 burst limit from config with plain-words lines on Billing. Reviewed the integrator's resolveTopups cutoff fix (b534c3b): agreed.
